## Details
### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-001** — Subscribe to Data-of-Interest Bus Messages

- **Description:** The mlog app shall subscribe to all data-of-interest software bus messages required for SD card logging.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: route all data-of-interest SB messages to mlog_lib for SD card persistence per SW-REQ-SYS-022 and SW-REQ-SYS-024.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-022
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-002** — Forward Records at Full Sample Rate

- **Description:** The mlog app shall forward each subscribed message to the mlog library without downsampling.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: persist each sensor sample at its full rate to satisfy raw fidelity logging.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-001
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-003** — Initiate New Log Run on Startup

- **Description:** The mlog app shall initiate a new log run via the mlog library at startup.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: each power-on starts a fresh log run distinct from prior runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-025
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-004** — Preserve Prior Log Runs on Startup

- **Description:** The mlog app shall not delete or overwrite prior log runs when initiating a new run.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: protect prior flight data against accidental overwrite between runs.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-055
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-005** — Stamp Forwarded Records With Monotonic Microseconds

- **Description:** The mlog app shall stamp each forwarded record with monotonic microseconds since startup.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: every record uses one canonical time source for cross-record alignment.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-026
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-006** — Per-Sample Timestamping

- **Description:** The mlog app shall include a timestamp on every individual sensor sample record forwarded to the library.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: per-sample timestamps required for accurate post-flight nav reconstruction.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-027
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-007** — Forward Verbatim NMEA Sentences

- **Description:** The mlog app shall forward GPS NMEA sentences to the mlog library without modification.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: preserve unmodified GPS source data for post-flight reconstruction.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-024
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-008** — Forward GPS UTC Records

- **Description:** The mlog app shall forward each received GPS UTC message to the mlog library.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: enables post-flight alignment of monotonic time to absolute UTC.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-028
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-009** — Continue After SD Write Failure

- **Description:** The mlog app shall continue forwarding subsequent records after the mlog library reports a write failure.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: SD failures must not halt mission; retry writes on subsequent records.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-035
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-010** — Expose SD Card Health to System Aggregator

- **Description:** The mlog app shall expose SD card write health to sys_app via the sd_lib health query interface.
- **Rationale:** PM Decision 3 (sprint 2026-05-02): SD health observability is delegated to sys_app's IsHealthy() poll model rather than a dedicated bus message; bitmap aggregation lives in sys_app per architecture.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-060
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-011** — POSIX Build Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The mlog app POSIX build shall be functionally equivalent to the Pico2 flight build.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: Trick simulation must exercise the same logging paths as flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-MLOG-APP-012** — Deterministic Forwarding

- **Description:** The mlog app shall produce deterministic forwarding outputs given identical bus message inputs.
- **Rationale:** Module purpose: determinism required for repeatable Trick sim runs and regression analysis.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Draft
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
